senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) Leviathan, a legendary sea-animal reserved, with B’hemoth, for the righteous in the hereafter.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 13:3">Lev. R. s. 13</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00183"><he>בְּהֵמוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 25b:4">M. Kat. 25ᵇ</cite> (in a wailing song) <he>ל׳</he> a great man, opp. <he>דגי רקק</he> the fish of the swamp, common humanity (v. <cite ref="A00964"><he>אֵזוֹב</he></cite>).
